mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is "HTTPS everywhere, no exceptions": plain HTTP is not permitted for internal hosts, and internal traffic is held to the same HTTPS requirement as any other traffic.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md

I created `docs/policies/internal-http.md`. It records the current decision as "HTTPS everywhere, no exceptions", so plain HTTP is not permitted for internal hosts. The older decision that allowed plain HTTP for internal hosts was retired, so the file doesn't mention it.

The decision comes from Muninn record #25, which the user stated directly. The shell command I first tried to write the file returned an error, so I wrote it with the file tool instead.
